title: MC /etc Eval-Pack (v0.1)
description: Structured eval-pack for the /etc authoring+eval harness. Captures procedures, a rubric with mechanical checks, and examples/counterexamples for a skill or prompt artifact. Anti-CoT: every field is structured JSON — no free-text reasoning dumps.

id.description: Unique identifier for this eval-pack (slug-based, e.g. 'etc-author').

target.description: Project-relative path to the skill/prompt artifact this pack evaluates.

procedures.description: Ordered list of key procedural steps the artifact should implement.

rubric.description: Evaluation rubric — one entry per scoring dimension.

weight.description: Relative weight of this dimension in the final confidence score.

criteria.description: Human-readable description of what this dimension checks.

mechanical.description: true = runnable mechanical checks; false = requires consult judgment.

checks.description: Mechanical checks for this dimension (empty array allowed for judgment-only).

kind.description: The type of mechanical check to run.

value.description: Check-specific value. Array of strings for contain checks, regex string for regex_match, {pattern,n} object for min_count/max_count.

examples.description: Positive examples showing what a passing artifact looks like.

expected_properties.description: Properties the artifact output should exhibit.

counterexamples.description: Negative examples showing what a failing artifact looks like.

must_not.description: Properties that must NOT be present in a passing artifact.

why.description: Rationale for why this is a counterexample.
